diffs.c0ffee14a:
diff --git a/target-app/services/orders/main.py b/target-app/services/orders/main.py
index 81a4b92..c0ffee1 100644
--- a/target-app/services/orders/main.py
+++ b/target-app/services/orders/main.py
@@ -38,6 +38,11 @@ async def create_order(request: Request):
     data = await request.json()
     price = float(data.get("price", 0.0))
 
+    # VIP discount code feature
+    discount = data.get("discount")
+    discount_code = discount["code"]
+    if discount_code == "VIP50":
+        price = price * 0.50
 
     order_id = f"ord_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
     save_order(order_id, price)
